knobs.note: BH-9074: seconds between two reads of GET /api/wakes?repo=harness%2Fbuild-queue inside one run, and the read timeout. A new queue row starts bin/fly-dispatch.sh and bin/fly-pool-tick.sh within about this many seconds. Read as ${POOL_WAKE_POLL_S:-10}; a value that is not 1..60 is one log line and 10.

BH-9074: how long one run polls. A poll starts only while elapsed + POOL_WAKE_POLL_S <= this window, so the run ends before the next cron minute takes its flock. Read as ${POOL_WAKE_POLL_WINDOW_S:-55}; a value that is not 1..58 is one log line and 55.

BH-9074: page size of one wakes read (the route clamps at 500). One poll folds every new queue row into one launch and moves the cursor to the last id read; with nothing new the read costs the same index seek as limit=1. Read as ${POOL_WAKE_POLL_LIMIT:-100}; a value that is not 1..500 is one log line and 100.
